summary: A sports club or amateur team: next match and recent results, league standings, a filterable fixtures and results page with 'Add to calendar', club news, the ground, and memberships.

pages.purpose: Matchday first: the next game, the latest results and where the club stands, then news, the ground and joining.

sections.purpose: Club name and crest, the next fixture as a ticket stub (opponent, competition, date, kick-off, venue) and the last three results.
fields: Next fixture: opponent, competition, date, kick-off time, home/away, venue, ticket link

sections.purpose: A league snapshot (top of the table plus the club) and top scorers.
alternatives: table: a sport without a league table, e.g. rankings or personal bests
fields: Table rows: position, team, played, points, form
sections.notes: Compact on the home page: top rows plus the club if lower, with a link to the full table.

sections.purpose: Latest club news: match reports, signings, community.
fields: News title, date, category, image, summary

sections.purpose: The home ground: photo, address, capacity, getting there.
alternatives: map-hours: the ground with a map and ticket office hours

sections.purpose: Invite visitors to become members or buy a season ticket.

pages.purpose: Every fixture and result of the season, filterable, with the full league table.

sections.purpose: Season, competitions and a note on kick-off times.
Fixtures/Results tabs, a team switch (first team, women, youth), competition filter and home/away; results add a record and a five-game form guide; fixtures get 'Add to calendar'.
alternatives: table: a short season shown as one table
fields: Fixture: date, kick-off, opponent, competition, home/away, venue
Result: score, scorers (optional), match report link
sections.notes: Group by month; mark the next game. 'Add to calendar' downloads a real .ics file with the right time zone and duration. Form guide shows W/D/L letters with spoken names, never colour alone. Announce the filtered count via aria-live.

sections.purpose: The full league table with promotion and relegation lines.
fields: Full table: played, won, drawn, lost, goals for/against, goal difference, points

pages.purpose: Choose a membership or season ticket, see how joining works and where you sit.

sections.purpose: Why become a member (ownership, votes, priority).
Membership tiers with price and what each includes.
How joining works, step by step.
The stands or seating areas and which memberships they suit.
alternatives: image-hotspots: a ground plan with selectable stands

sections.purpose: Instalments, missed games, cup games, accessibility.

fields: Ticket office hours, phone and email

content: Club name, crest, colours and founding year
Season fixtures with dates, kick-off times, competitions, venues
Results with scores (kept up to date after every game)
League table and top scorers (source and update routine)
Ground name, address, capacity, transport, accessible seating
Membership tiers, prices, benefits and joining steps

styles.name: matchday poster
styles.why: Condensed poster headlines, the club colour as accent and dense tables; suits football and most team sports.

styles.name: floodlights
styles.why: Dark, high-energy look for clubs with a strong matchday and media presence.

pitfalls: Results and the table go stale after a match; agree who updates them and show the matchday they reflect.
Win/draw/loss shown only by colour; add W/D/L letters.
Kick-off times without the time zone, and .ics files with the wrong zone or duration.
Photos of youth players published without guardian consent.
Membership prices without saying what is included (cup games, away games) or the instalment terms.
Huge unfiltered fixture tables on phones; use filters and month groups.
